mapper.select: SELECT ADDRESS_NO AS addressNo, MEMBER_NO AS memberNo, RECEIVER_NAME AS receiverName, TEL AS tel, ZIPCODE AS zipcode, ADDRESS AS address, DETAIL_ADDRESS AS detailAddress, REQUEST_MSG AS requestMsg, ADDRESS_DEFAULT AS addressDefault FROM DELIVERY_ADDRESS WHERE MEMBER_NO = #{memberNo} AND ADDRESS_DEFAULT = 'Y'

SELECT ADDRESS_NO AS addressNo, MEMBER_NO AS memberNo, RECEIVER_NAME AS receiverName, TEL AS tel, ZIPCODE AS zipcode, ADDRESS AS address, DETAIL_ADDRESS AS detailAddress, REQUEST_MSG AS requestMsg, ADDRESS_DEFAULT AS addressDefault FROM DELIVERY_ADDRESS WHERE MEMBER_NO = #{memberNo} ORDER BY ADDRESS_DEFAULT DESC, ADDRESS_NO DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE DELIVERY_ADDRESS SET ADDRESS_DEFAULT = 'N' WHERE MEMBER_NO = #{memberNo} AND ADDRESS_DEFAULT = 'Y'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO DELIVERY_ADDRESS ( ADDRESS_NO, MEMBER_NO, RECEIVER_NAME, TEL, ZIPCODE, ADDRESS, DETAIL_ADDRESS, REQUEST_MSG, ADDRESS_DEFAULT ) VALUES ( SEQ_ADDRESS_NO.NEXTVAL, #{memberNo}, #{receiverName}, #{tel}, #{zipcode}, #{address}, #{detailAddress}, #{requestMsg}, #{addressDefault} )
